origin: Authored by hand for SP-15. NOT captured from a session and not derived from any existing benchmark file.

files.session_go_read_2.txt: second read, after a field was added
files.session_go_read_3.txt: third and final read, after the API changed

what_it_demonstrates: This is the counterpart of the two approximate fixtures: an EXACT claim, checked exactly. Three reads of one normalized path in one session; the first two were replaced by a later read of the same path and the third was not. The test asserts the reported list element for element rather than asserting a count or a subset, because an exact claim is one that can be checked exactly.
qualified_claim_this_supports: Superseded is exact: a tool use is superseded when a later tool use on the same normalized path replaced it. No sketch, no estimate, and recomputable from index/tool_use.jsonl by anyone who doubts it.
scope_of_the_claim: Exact over the record set the scan observed, and about the recorded history rather than about the world. An edit the observer never saw (SP05-D1) is one no scan of the index can know about, so a record absent from the list is not thereby established to be current.
